scope: Priced catalogue add-on named against cart rows («las de <opción> con extra queso», «ponle X a las de <opción>», «échale X a todas»)
baselineFindings: «las de A con extra queso» and «a las de B agregale extra queso» (reversed word order) appended a free note «con extra queso» to the row
«las de A con queso extra», «B con extra queso», «las de A con extra de queso» added ONE add-on unit for 3 or 2 dishes, with a junk note «con …»
«ponle queso extra a las de A» saved the literal sentence as a free note and moved awaiting_final_confirm back to building_cart
«échale queso extra a todas» answered «no manejamos» while offering that same add-on
fix: tryHandleLineScopedPaidAddon (early group, right after tryHandlePartialUnitOptionChange). Scope: rows currently holding a named option, or every non-add-on row for todas/todos. The tail must name exactly one catalogue product by word set (any order, de/con/articles ignored, adicional≡extra, trailing plural s dropped) with no configurable options. It is added with one unit per referenced dish and note «para <línea>» via addProductToCart mode set, so repeating the same request is idempotent and answered «Ya tenía». Unavailable add-on is named and nothing changes. Questions, digits, other pending selections and tails that do not name a catalogue product keep their existing routes. No restaurant names/IDs/prices in the rule.
